title: Valid login with correct username and password
description: A registered user can authenticate with valid credentials and reach the shop
preconditions: Browser open at the login page; account standard_user exists
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username 'standard_user'; 3) Enter password 'secret_sauce'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Greeting 'Xin chào, standard_user' is shown; 'Đăng xuất' control is visible; product heading 'Sản phẩm nổi bật' is rendered
postconditions: User session is active on the shop
notes: Happy path; covered by existing spec

title: Login fails with valid username and wrong password
description: System rejects a valid username paired with an incorrect password
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username 'standard_user'; 3) Enter password 'wrong_password'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Error 'Tên đăng nhập hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.' is shown; user remains on the login form; no greeting is displayed

title: Login fails with unknown username and valid password
description: System rejects an unknown username even with an otherwise valid password
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username 'invalid_user'; 3) Enter password 'secret_sauce'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Error 'Tên đăng nhập hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.' is shown; user remains on the login form

title: Login fails with invalid username and invalid password
description: System rejects login when both credentials are wrong
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username 'invalid_user'; 3) Enter password 'wrong_password'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Error 'Tên đăng nhập hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.' is shown; user stays on login form; no greeting for 'invalid_user'

title: Login blocked with empty username
description: System does not authenticate when the username field is empty
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Leave username empty; 3) Enter password 'secret_sauce'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Login is rejected; validation or credential error is shown; user remains on the login form; no session created
notes: ASSUMPTION: empty username is invalid input; confirm exact message/validation behavior with app

title: Login blocked with empty password
description: System does not authenticate when the password field is empty
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username 'standard_user'; 3) Leave password empty; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Login is rejected; validation or credential error is shown; user remains on the login form; no session created
notes: ASSUMPTION: empty password is invalid input; confirm exact behavior with app

title: Login blocked with both fields empty
description: System does not authenticate when both fields are empty
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Leave username and password empty; 3) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Login is rejected; user remains on the login form; no session created

title: Username with leading/trailing whitespace
description: System handles surrounding spaces in the username consistently
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username ' standard_user ' (with surrounding spaces); 3) Enter password 'secret_sauce'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Behavior is consistent and documented: either username is trimmed and login succeeds, OR credentials error is shown; no partial/ambiguous state
notes: ASSUMPTION: trim policy unspecified; record actual behavior as the oracle

title: Username is case-sensitive
description: Verify whether the username matching is case-sensitive
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username 'STANDARD_USER'; 3) Enter password 'secret_sauce'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Result matches the specified matching policy (expected: credentials error if case-sensitive); no session unless policy allows it
notes: ASSUMPTION: username expected case-sensitive; confirm with spec

title: Password is case-sensitive
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username 'standard_user'; 3) Enter password 'SECRET_SAUCE'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Error 'Tên đăng nhập hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.' is shown; no session created
notes: Password matching should always be case-sensitive

title: Password input is masked
description: The password field obscures typed characters
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Type any value into the password field; 3) Observe the rendered characters
expected_results: Characters are masked (input type=password); the raw value is not shown as plain text on screen

title: SQL injection attempt in username is rejected
description: Malicious SQL-like input must not authenticate or error out unsafely
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username ' OR '1'='1 ; 3) Enter password ' OR '1'='1 ; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: Login is rejected with the standard credentials error; no session created; no server error / stack trace exposed

title: XSS attempt in username is neutralized
description: Script payload in the username must not execute
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter username '<script>alert(1)</script>'; 3) Enter password 'secret_sauce'; 4) Click 'Đăng nhập'
expected_results: No script executes (no alert dialog); input is escaped/sanitized; login is rejected with the standard error

title: Error message does not reveal which field is wrong
description: A generic error prevents username enumeration
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Attempt login with valid username + wrong password (TC-LOGIN-002); 2) Attempt login with unknown username + any password (TC-LOGIN-003); 3) Compare the two error messages
expected_results: Both attempts return the same generic message 'Tên đăng nhập hoặc mật khẩu không đúng.'; the message does not indicate which field failed

title: Logout ends the session
description: After a successful login the user can log out and return to the login form
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
steps: 1) Log in with valid credentials; 2) Click 'Đăng xuất'
expected_results: User is logged out; the login form ('Đăng nhập' button) is shown again; protected shop content is no longer accessible

title: Page reload ends the session
description: The session is not persisted across a full page reload
preconditions: User is logged in as standard_user
steps: 1) Log in with valid credentials; 2) Reload the page
expected_results: Login form ('Đăng nhập' button) is shown again; the user must re-authenticate; prior cart/session state is cleared
notes: Observed in cart TC-27: reload returns to login

title: Shop is not reachable without authentication
description: Unauthenticated access presents the login form instead of shop content
preconditions: Fresh browser with no active session
steps: 1) Navigate to the app URL without logging in
expected_results: Login form is presented; no product add-to-cart controls and no cart control are reachable
notes: Covered by cart 'not authenticated' negative test

title: Submit login form with the Enter key
description: The form can be submitted from the keyboard without clicking the button
preconditions: Browser open at the login page
steps: 1) Navigate to login page; 2) Enter valid username; 3) Enter valid password; 4) Press Enter in the password field
expected_results: Login is submitted and succeeds identically to clicking 'Đăng nhập'; greeting 'Xin chào, standard_user' is shown
notes: ASSUMPTION: Enter-to-submit is expected; confirm with app
